categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Scripts and tools' label and modifies the startup initialization of bitcoin-util, bitcoin-tx, and bitcoin-wallet.
categories.rationale: Enables hardware-accelerated SHA-256 for standalone CLI utilities, speeding up hashing workloads significantly. Author benchmarks demonstrate that 'grind is ~5x faster and signing 2000 P2PKH inputs with bitcoin-tx ~2.3x'.
